faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Office Assistant position at IIT Madras is 21st August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have passed 10th or 12th grade, or possess a Diploma or equivalent qualification. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and basic computer knowledge is also desired.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Office Assistant post is 25 years. There might be age relaxations for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Office Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Office Assistant position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 18,000, depending on their experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the information available, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the IIT Madras Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test, an Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the type of job for this Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the IIT Madras located?
faq.answer: IIT Madras is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600036.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of IIT Madras or via the direct application link provided in the important links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. What are the desired skills for the Office Assistant role?
faq.answer: Desired skills include basic communication abilities, computer knowledge, and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications like Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
